facts.fact: L'Essor reports the permanent secretary for land reform saying Ninacad-Adresse, a six-digit code per plot with a secure database, covers about 1,500,000 plots in Bamako, parts of Kati and Segou, with deployment in Koulikoro and Sikasso under way.
